The post-lyophilization residual moisture content of selected samples was analyzed using Metrohm 851 Titrando Coulometer with an 874 Oven processor and autosampler. Two-thirds of the samples in cases SM1–SM3 were used to compare the residual moisture content for conventional versus qRF microwave-assisted lyophilization processes.
